name: reason
label: REASON
title: Reason: the part everyone's excited about
summary: Reasoning models can stand in for a person in two places: finding the way the first time, and repairing when the controls change. Everywhere else, paying a model to reason through the same path again is the token maxing Hightower warned about. Useful at the edges; wasted in the middle.
cite: The hype, kept at the edges
